justification: Panel A depicts a horizontal register of stylized animals (birds, quadrupeds) and geometric bands carved into a slab, while Panel B depicts a single anthropomorphic figure with facial features and hands folded over the torso, carved into a monolithic block. The only broad correspondence is that both are relief-carved stone surfaces with schematic, non-naturalistic figural conventions, but the actual subject matter, composition, and figure-to-figure relationships are entirely different.
